anomalies.description: A large crowd is gathered in a street, with individuals actively engaging in violent unrest: a dumpster or vehicle is engulfed in flames, people are throwing objects, and some appear to be clashing with authorities or other groups. The scene shows sustained collective violence beyond peaceful protest.

A group of individuals, some wearing high-visibility vests, forcefully move and throw a large blue box (possibly a vending machine or kiosk) toward a building entrance; subsequent frames show police in riot gear advancing amid smoke and chaos.; Intense street-level unrest with heavy pink/red smoke (likely from flares or tear gas), multiple figures in riot gear moving through the scene, civilians reacting, and apparent property damage or looting near storefronts.

Large plumes of pink smoke (likely from flares or smoke bombs) fill a street at night, with multiple individuals visible in the background moving erratically; one person in foreground wears a scarf over face and carries a bag, suggesting unrest or protest escalation.

A reporter in a blue jacket is on a wet urban street at night, with chaotic background activity including figures in motion, bright lights, and what appears to be a decorated vehicle or float; ambient conditions suggest ongoing public disorder.

Two individuals on a wet sidewalk engage in physical confrontation: one in dark coat appears to lunge or strike toward the other, who is in motion with arms raised defensively; background shows storefronts and wet pavement, consistent with street-level altercation.

A dark sedan (possibly police) appears to make contact with or narrowly miss a white sedan parked or stopped on the wet road; rear lights flare and vehicle positions shift abruptly across frames f0–f2, suggesting a low-speed collision or near-collision. No clear post-impact deformation is visible due to resolution and motion blur, but the abrupt change in relative position and light reflection pattern supports a minor impact event.

A sudden, bright yellow-orange flash erupts from near the ground in front of a dark sedan, expanding rapidly with smoke and debris—consistent with a high-energy explosion (e.g., pipe rupture or incendiary device). The blast occurs while the car is stationary or slowly moving, and bystanders are visible nearby.

A violent confrontation between police in full riot gear and a group of protesters, involving coordinated physical force, crowd suppression, and multiple individuals being forcibly taken to the ground in an urban street setting.

Police officers in riot gear are actively restraining and subduing multiple individuals who are on the ground, some appearing non-resisting or incapacitated; actions include pushing, kneeling on, and dragging individuals, consistent with abuse of a helpless victim.

Sustained violent group confrontation between multiple police officers in riot gear and a dense crowd of protesters, involving shoving, pushing, and close physical engagement; the scene shows collective unrest with no clear separation between law enforcement and demonstrators.

A police officer in riot gear is seen actively engaging in physical combat with a person in the crowd; the officer appears to be grabbing or striking the individual while other officers surround them.

A tense confrontation between police in riot gear and a group of protesters, some seated or kneeling on the ground, with raised hands and defensive postures; officers advance with batons while protesters resist nonviolently but assertively, indicating collective unrest and imminent escalation.

A protester wearing a beanie and scarf is on the ground with arms outstretched in a non-threatening posture (frames f7–f9); an officer in riot gear is positioned directly over them, holding a baton in a threatening manner, suggesting potential use of force against a helpless individual.

Mutual physical engagement occurs: a hooded protester extends arms toward officers while another individual appears to push or strike at an officer’s baton (frames f10–f15); officers respond with batons raised, indicating reciprocal physical confrontation rather than one-sided restraint.

A tense confrontation between a group of protesters (some wearing black hooded clothing and masks) and police officers in riot gear, involving repeated aggressive gesturing, shoving, and physical contact; the crowd is densely packed and actively engaging with officers holding batons.; Police escalate response: an officer uses a megaphone to issue commands while multiple officers advance in formation, maintaining close proximity to agitated protesters; the situation remains volatile with ongoing verbal and physical tension.

Direct physical contact occurs: a protester in black reaches out and makes contact with an officer’s upper body/face area while other officers move in; visible pushing and grabbing suggests mutual engagement rather than one-sided assault.
